query:
-- Count items that DON'T have a direct tag match
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.equipamentoTag) as nao_match
FROM item_despesa_importado i
LEFT JOIN equipamentos e ON e.codigoTag = i.equipamentoTag
WHERE i.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND e.id IS NULL;
